description: Australia: can I retire at 60 with $500k in super (or any age and balance)? Year by year to 95 for one person or a couple: super guarantee and salary sacrifice (15% contributions tax), super from preservation age 60 into a tax-free account-based pension with the minimum drawdowns, the Age Pension from 67 under the income test (deeming, Work Bonus) and assets test (homeowner or not) from 20 September 2026, an optional UK State Pension (frozen in Australia), and tax (14% band from 2027-28, LITO, SAPTO, Medicare levy). Returns the age the money lasts to, bridge years to 67, wealth at retirement, the spending that lasts to 95, a retire-at-60/62/65 comparison and key years in today’s money.
